extraction.Name: Angelique Scissons (Swagger)
extraction.Recorded patent: was recorded by the Gregory County Abstract Company September 28, 1920
extraction.Buyer: The land was mortgaged October 11, 1920, by Angelique Scissons Swagger and Jesse E. Swagger to the State of South Dakota for $5000; then on January 17, 1924, Angelique Swagger and husband conveyed by deed to Jeffrey H. Scissons for consideration of $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612829 issued; South half of Northwest quarter and South half of Northeast quarter Section 33, township 97, north of range 69; receipt for patent was signed by the allottee February 14, 1918; husband is Jesse E. Swagger
